title: Gift-Idea Backlog and Occasion Countdown
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftidea:item
| eval days_to=round((occasion_epoch-now())/86400,0)
| where status="idea" AND days_to>0 AND days_to<45
| sort days_to
description: Surfaces the gift ideas you saved for upcoming birthdays and occasions in time to actually buy them.
value: Good gift ideas struck at random moments are worthless if forgotten; a countdown makes sure they get used.
implementation: Log gift ideas with target occasions into `index=personal`; surface ideas for occasions coming up soon.
visualization: Table of gift ideas by days until the occasion.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds you of the gift ideas you jotted down, in time to buy them before the birthday or occasion.
